name: Wadamesh-tak beta_108.10
body:
**Wadamesh-tak beta_108.10**: fork build 10 on top of Wadamesh beta_108, adding MeshCore Open TAK photos and voice, OTP Messenger and Team. Built from `5612a84896b37b69165678c8557290a0120da7d0`.

Boards: T-Deck, ThinkNode M9, T-LoRa Pager (SX1262 or LR1121), Heltec V4 and V4-R8 with the TFT, Seeed Wio Tracker L2, Elecrow CrowPanel Advance 3.5, 5 and 7 inch, T-Display P4 AMOLED or LCD (-lcd; SX1262 or LR2021; -at for units whose C6 still runs the factory ESP-AT). Easiest: the MediaMesh Flasher, https://cascadiamesh.org/mediamesh-flasher/. First USB install on any board: flash the `-merged.bin` at 0x0 (the plain `.bin` only suits a board already running this fork; several boards need this once for their bigger app slots, the P4 because its app starts at 0x20000). Identity, contacts and channels are kept; on-device settings and saved Wi-Fi reset. P4: the plain variant unless its C6 still runs the factory ESP-AT. If the screen stays black after flashing, unplug the board and plug it back in.

Fork devices install this from **Settings > About > Install update**. To flash by USB, use a `-merged.bin`. Every app image carries a `.sig` that the device checks before installing.
